What's new

What changed in each release of Tuned, and when.

  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 1.13.0

    Tuned 1.13 adds Tuned accounts, so every device keeps the same playlists and settings, plus new home screen widgets and casting that ends when you close the player.

    November 19, 2026
  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 1.12.0

    Tuned 1.12 adds signing in on a TV with your phone, the new channel stack icon, a cleaner player with fit and lock buttons, and remote-friendly screens on TVs and tablets.

    November 19, 2026
  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 1.11.0

    Tuned 1.11 is a big one: your own lists beside Favourites, MAC portals, renaming channels, sound delay, background play, lighter mode for slow TV boxes, a new look for Settings, and What's new.

    November 18, 2026
  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 1.10.0

    Tuned 1.10 casts saved films and episodes to your TV straight from the phone.

    November 18, 2026
  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 1.9.1

    Tuned 1.9.1 makes casting saved films and episodes more dependable.

    November 18, 2026
  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 1.9.0

    Tuned 1.9 adds avatars on Who's watching and quick filters on Live TV for sports, PPV, country and language.

    November 18, 2026
  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 1.8.0

    Tuned 1.8 makes the player, guide and Settings work with TalkBack and large text, and adds search in Settings.

    November 18, 2026
  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 1.7.0

    Tuned 1.7 adds catch-up for plain M3U playlists, media buttons and the Assistant in the player, and makes downloads always wait while you watch.

    November 18, 2026
  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 1.6.0

    Tuned 1.6 lets you search Countries and languages as you type, with a couple of tidy-ups in Settings.

    November 17, 2026
  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 1.5.0

    Tuned 1.5 adds the Google Play build with Tuned Premium, the HQ button, Jump to live, a scroll bar on long lists and a time zone setting for the guide.

    November 17, 2026
  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 1.4.0

    Tuned 1.4 adds profiles with kids profiles and PINs, the Live Events page, recording, channel numbers, guide fixes, Trakt and subtitle search.

    November 17, 2026
  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 1.3.0

    Tuned 1.3 is about speed and staying up: faster Live TV and Shows, backup copies when a channel dies, a full grid guide, pause and rewind live TV, and actor pages.

    November 17, 2026
  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 1.2.0

    Tuned 1.2 adds tablet layouts, Skip intro, Watch later, subtitle timing, language filters and a channel scan that hides channels that never play.

    November 17, 2026
  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 1.1.0

    Tuned 1.1 brings film pages with ratings and trailers, downloads for watching offline, casting to Chromecast and DLNA TVs, catch-up, and Android TV.

    November 17, 2026
  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 1.0.0

    Tuned 1.0 adds search everywhere (with your voice), Continue Watching, guide reminders, player gestures and tools, and a parental PIN for adult categories.

    November 17, 2026
  • What's new

    What's new in Tuned 0.1.0

    The first build of Tuned: a native IPTV player for Android, with a playlist and guide kept on the device, Live TV, Movies and Shows, and auto-tune to find a working stream for a live event.

    November 17, 2026
